title: Building Claim Payments on the NFIP General Property Form and RCBAP Flood Policies (Write Your Own)
content:
Building claim payments on the NFIP General Property Form and RCBAP Flood Policies (Write Your Own) are issued by the claims desk on the policy's claim that carries its latest adjuster report, for that claim's date of loss, one payment item at a time.

**Condition of issue.** A building payment on a claim is not issued until the claim file carries a signed and sworn building proof of loss received after the claim's latest adjuster report that measures a building loss. Put the other way round: while the claim file shows no building proof of loss received later than the latest adjuster report measuring a building loss, no building payment is issued on that claim.

**Payee.** The payee follows the mortgagee rule: a building payment names the insured and the mortgagee of record when the policy shows a mortgagee and the tier names the mortgagee on building payments, and the insured alone otherwise.

## Situation of use and capability

Issuing a building claim payment books one payment item for the building coverage on a flood claim under a General Property Form or RCBAP policy, dated the day it is issued, with a newly assigned payment reference, and adds it to the net claim money paid on the policy. The customer can then be told the amount, the payee line and the payment reference.

## How it is invoked

The tool is `issue_building_claim_payment_972d0779`, an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it and then calls it. One call issues one payment item.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format / values |
|---|---|---|
| `nfipcom_policy_id` | the reference number of the General Property Form or RCBAP policy the claim is made under, as returned by the policy lookup for the customer | identifier |
| `claim_number` | the claim number the payment is issued under, exactly as it appears on the claim file or as the customer states it | verbatim text |
| `date_of_loss` | the date the flood loss occurred on that claim | YYYY-MM-DD |
| `payment_amount` | the amount of this building payment item | USD, positive, 2 decimal places; stored rounded half-up to the cent |
| `payee` | the payee line printed on the payment | `INSURED` — no mortgagee of record is shown on the policy, so the named insured alone is paid; `INSURED_AND_MORTGAGEE` — a mortgagee of record is shown on the policy and the building payment names both; `NONE` — the marker used on claim entries that are not payments, never the payee line of a payment item |

## Return

A receipt with `payment_id` (the reference of the new claim-file entry), `payment_ref` (the newly assigned payment reference of the check or transfer), `claim_number`, `coverage_part` (always `BUILDING`), `payment_amount` (USD, 2 decimal places), `payee` (as passed) and `issued_date` (YYYY-MM-DD, the day of issue). The presence of `payment_ref` means the payment was issued. No other return or error behaviour is defined.
